description: This PHP source file handles the display and generation of HTML options for selecting report columns in the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions to generate primary and secondary column options based on modules and their associated fields, and constructs the interface for managing report columns.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template object used for rendering the report columns interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryColumnsHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML option groups for primary module fields to be used in report column selection.

methods.name: getSecondaryColumnsHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML option groups for secondary modules fields to be used in report column selection.
